vocabulary_extraction: Exact original model metadata bytes retained; GGUF tensor count set to zero, tensor records/data removed, padding aligned to 32 bytes. No token text/score/attributes or special metadata was synthesized.
comparison: Candidate IDs/order, selected index, sorted flag, pointer offset, all represented float bits, grammar allowed-token masks, history transitions, clone/copy/reset, and real-context generated IDs are exact. All expected data originate from original DLL; no Rust-produced expectations.
target_scope: Native stream, ordering, and lazy regex parity measured on Windows x64 MSVC. Grammar and DRY regression replay also run on other Rust platforms; full cross-vendor C++ sampler parity remains open.
ordinary_tests: crates/ffi/src/sampler_reference_tests.rs uses the 11,360-byte vocabulary-only fixture; actual trained-model execution is an external harness gate.
